name: Uzzek
summary: Uzzek watches the eastern Barrens from southwest of Far Watch Post. The battle-hardened orc survived many skirmishes across Kalimdor and now tests and trains promising Horde warriors crossing the plains.

sections.title: Veteran of the Plains
sections.body: Uzzek trains young warriors southwest of Far Watch Post, near the eastern edge of the Barrens. He endured brutal combat in the recent wars and now tests those learning to defend themselves. To prove their skill, they face the savage wildlife and raiders that trouble the crossing.

faq.answer: Uzzek is a veteran orc warrior stationed in the eastern Barrens, just southwest of Far Watch Post. He guides aspiring Horde warriors learning defensive combat.
You can find Uzzek along the bluffs southwest of Far Watch Post, overlooking the road from Durotar into the Barrens.

faq.q: What role does Uzzek play for Horde warriors?
faq.answer: Uzzek tests young warriors' stamina and resolve with trials such as the Path of Defense. Then he directs them to seasoned masters like Thun'grim Firegaze.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face Uzzek's tests of grit and defensive skill as you leave your first training grounds for the wider Barrens.
As a member of the Horde, you find Uzzek near Far Watch Post, among the veteran defenders watching the vulnerable border between Durotar and the untamed savanna.
